note: blake3Compress / blake3Hash on a real @bsv/sdk Spend. No signature: the witness is the hash preimage. Honest digests are independent of the codegen: the 64-byte official BLAKE3 KAT (conformance/runtime-vectors/blake3-official-kat.json, input_len 64 = blake3Compress(IV, input) with block_len 64 and flags CHUNK_START|CHUNK_END|ROOT), and a BLAKE3 (spec §2) compress reference in packages/runar-testing/src/__tests__/f114-compress-operand-size-vm.test.ts that is itself pinned to that KAT. F-114: the compiled blake3Compress aborts unless the block is 64 bytes and the chaining value 32 bytes. Before F-114 a 65-byte block B || 0x01 (the 65th byte is the 2^32 bit of an addend, truncated by num2le) and a 60..63-byte block (short last word zero-extended) produced the committed digest of a DIFFERENT 64-byte block and Spend accepted them. The interpreter verdict is asserted equal to the Spend verdict on every row.

spends.note: Honest: 32-byte IV (LE) + the 64-byte KAT input; expected = official BLAKE3 KAT hash for input_len 64.
F-114 forced near-miss: 65-byte block KAT || 0x01 with the honest digest. Accepted by Spend before F-114 (same digest); now refused by the block-size guard.
63-byte block (KAT input minus its last byte) with the KAT digest: refused by the block-size guard.
33-byte chaining value IV || 0x01 with the honest digest: refused by the chaining-value size guard.
Honest zero-tail block (the 64-byte block (i*37+11) mod 256 with its last four bytes zeroed); expected from the KAT-pinned reference compress.
F-114 forced near-miss: the 63-byte prefix of the zero-tail block, whose short last word zero-extends to the honest word. Accepted by Spend before F-114 (same digest); now refused.
F-114 forced near-miss: the 60-byte prefix of the zero-tail block (empty last word reads as 0). Accepted by Spend before F-114; now refused.
blake3Hash of the 64-byte KAT input equals the official KAT (blake3Hash is unguarded by F-114: it builds its own 64-byte block).
65-byte message is outside blake3Hash's single-block domain: refused (negative OP_NUM2BIN pad).
